finding: Independent comparative convergence audit: Package 126 R4 Anderson acceleration demonstrated exact machine-precision parity with Package 125 across Cycles 1-5 (0.000000 N RF2 diff), but subsequently induced oscillatory iteration across Cycles 6-40 (21 proposals accepted, 13 safeguard fallbacks). While Package 125 monotonic AM reduced Delta d to 0.001187 and Delta RF2 to 0.0707 N, Anderson acceleration amplified terminal Delta d by 2.30x (to 0.002734) and terminal Delta RF2 by 32.6x (to 2.3065 N), cycling RF2 between 175.7 N and 183.5 N. Spatial audit shows crack tip position at d>=0.5 differs by < 1 element width (Dice overlap = 0.985), proving acceleration oscillates around the same physical softening crack band rather than branching to a distinct macroscopic crack path. Classification: ACCELERATION_CAUSES_OSCILLATORY_ITERATION.
